page.overview:
Who is Gene Belcher?

Eugene "Gene" Belcher is the second child of Bob and Linda Belcher and the brother of Tina and Louise Belcher. He makes his first appearance in Season 25 episode "Homerland" during the closing credits.

During the closing credits in "Homerland", Gene and his family were in the Simpson House celebrating the 25th season.

When Homer ended entering and became stuck in Bob's Burgers restaurant, Gene and his family were watching him. When Gene asked Bob if he wanted to keep him, Bob said no. When Bob said that he couldn't call someone Bob, told him that he could call someone Bob. After Tina pointed out that Homer might be looking for the bathroom, Gene told Homer to go anywhere, saying he'll clean it up, then added, "no way".
